title: Product Designer, Higher Education
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Education team is focused on making AI safe, useful, and empowering for students, faculty, and institutions.

Our work spans core learning experiences, course-based tools, and campus-wide product solutions. We’re also exploring how OpenAI’s technology can support colleges and universities, educators, teaching and research, and collaborative learning.

About the Role

We’re looking for a staff-level product designer to shape how students and educators engage with AI and help define OpenAI’s emerging higher education experiences. You’ll work across immediate product needs and ambitious zero-to-one opportunities, from core learning and course experiences to campus-wide tools for teaching, research, and collaboration.

A high craft bar is imperative. You’ll be expected to pair exceptional interaction and visual design with deep product thinking-turning complex questions around safety, learning, and institutional needs into experiences that feel clear, trustworthy, and engaging.

This is a highly generative role for someone who can move from early exploration to concrete, high-fidelity product direction. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, research, safety, policy, and design to establish durable patterns for a space that is still being defined.

In this role, you will:

- Establish an exceptionally high standard for craft across OpenAI’s higher education experiences.

- Lead end-to-end design for products that help students, faculty, and campus staff use AI safely, confidently, and productively.

- Design clear, trustworthy experiences for learning, course participation, and campus-wide use, including sensitive or high-trust interactions.

- Shape zero-to-one higher education experiences spanning colleges and universities, educators, courses, collaborative work, and builder-style workflows.

- Turn emerging ideas into compelling concepts, prototypes, and high-fidelity product experiences that teams can evaluate and build.

- Partner with research, engineering, product, safety, policy, and design to balance user needs, technical capabilities, and responsible deployment.

- Conduct and apply research with relevant users and partners to understand the needs of students, faculty, campus staff, and institutions.

- Develop reusable patterns and principles that create coherence across core learning, course, and campus-wide products as the area grows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Bring exceptional interaction and visual design craft and are motivated to raise the quality of design across OpenAI.

- Are a highly generative designer who explores broadly, iterates deeply, and turns ideas into concrete, polished product direction.

- Pair strong craft with deep product and systems thinking.

- Have led substantial, ambiguous, or zero-to-one product areas and can help shape both vision and execution.

- Can design thoughtful experiences for sensitive, high-trust, or safety-critical contexts.

- Understand how to create products that are engaging and intuitive without compromising safety or clarity.

- Can navigate the needs of multiple audiences, including students, faculty, campus staff, administrators, and institutional partners.

- Communicate clearly, build alignment across disciplines, and remain hands-on throughout the product-development process.

- Are energized by the opportunity to define how AI can support learning while serving higher education communities responsibly.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. title: Senior Rust Consultant / Engineer (m/w/d)
description:

Deine Rolle in unserem Ökosystem
Wenn wir dich mit einer Organisation aus unserem Netzwerk verbinden, erwartet dich keine Standard-Anstellung, sondern eine Schlüsselposition an der Schnittstelle von High-End Engineering und Strategie:

•
Deep-Tech Projekte: Du entwickelst geschäftskritische Systeme (Schwerpunkt Rust) und baust skalierbare, transparente Architekturen.

•
Strategische Beratung: Du berätst Kunden auf C-Level- und Architekturebene. Du hilfst ihnen, die Balance zwischen Innovation und wirtschaftlicher Nachhaltigkeit zu finden.

Open-Source-First: Du arbeitest in Umfeldern, die offene Standards und digitale Souveränität als strategischen Vorteil begreifen.

•
Handlungsspielraum: Du genießt volles Vertrauen, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und setzt Best Practices ohne bürokratische Einschränkungen um.

Qualifikation
Dein Profil (Skill Checkliste)

•
Rust-Expertise: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung. Sicherer Umgang mit Ownership, Lifetimes und Async-Rust (Tokio) auf Experten-Niveau.

•
Consulting-Mindset: Du bist es gewohnt, komplexe Sachverhalte zu strukturieren und sicher vor Gruppen und Entscheidern zu vertreten. Du bist rhetorisch sicher und fachlich unantastbar.

•
Ergebnisorientierung: Qualität statt Versprechen. Nachweis durch Rust-Code-Referenzen oder Repositories zwingend erforderlich.

•
Verantwortungsbewusstsein: Du suchst eine Vollzeit-Herausforderung, in der du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst. Eine moderate Reisebereitschaft zum Kunden setzen wir voraus.

Benefits
Was dich bei unseren Partnern erwartet

•
Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Gehaltsspannen zwischen 70.000 € und 90.000 € (je nach Seniorität und Impact auch darüber hinaus) sowie faire Bonusmodelle.

•
Moderne Arbeitskultur: Gelebte Remote-Kultur (deutschlandweit), flexible Strukturen und Teams aus erfahrenen Senior Engineers.

•
High-End Tech-Stacks: Fokus auf Rust und Go, ergänzt durch Cloud-Native Technologien (Kubernetes, NixOS, AWS/Azure).

Der Hackstack-Vorteil: Wir begleiten dich langfristig
Wir vermitteln dich nicht einfach und verschwinden dann. Als Teil unseres Kollektivs profitierst du von einem nachhaltigen Partner-Modell:

•
Mission-Match: Wir schlagen dir nur Organisationen vor, deren Werte - Integrität, Transparenz und technologische Exzellenz - mit unseren übereinstimmen.

•
Karriere-Kontinuität: Sollte ein Projekt oder eine Zusammenarbeit enden, sind wir bereits an deiner Seite. Wir unterstützen dich proaktiv dabei, das nächste spannende Kapitel in unserem Netzwerk aufzuschlagen.

title: Senior Solutions Architect – Large Scale AI Inference
description:
We are looking for a Senior Solutions Architect with deep experience in large-scale production AI inference. You will collaborate with top EMEA AI Natives, AI infrastructure providers, and enterprises deploying AI at scale. As a trusted technical leader, you will ensure NVIDIA 's inference stack achieves best performance, efficiency, and reliability. You will address the industry's toughest AI inference challenges at the intersection of AI and high-performance computing, driving innovations in areas such as multi-node Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving, interconnect-aware scheduling, memory-bound workload optimization, and next-generation inference architectures. Your work will establish the technical direction for scalable, high-performance AI inference across the most demanding production environments.
What you will be doing:

• Guide EMEA AI Natives customers in deploying and optimizing large-scale inference workloads on multi-node GPU clusters.

• Architect efficient inference pipelines for dense and sparse/latent MoE models distributing workload among thousands of GPUs.

• Improve inference efficiency across quantization (INT4/FP8), speculative decoding, disaggregated prefill/decode, KV cache management, and WideEP for large MoE deployments.

• Collaborate with NVIDIA product teams (Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, NIXL) to accelerate customer success.

• Animate the AI inference developer’s community across EMEA through technical workshops, hackathons, and reference architectures.

What we need to see

• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, High-Performance Computing, or equivalent professional experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Neural Networks inference optimization.

• Solid understanding of transformers inference optimization: quantization, disaggregated inference, speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV cache optimization.

• Practical experience in MoE inference at scale: expert parallelism, WideEP, all-to-all communication, routing overhead, and load balancing at scale.

• Ability to engage effectively with ML engineers, researchers, and systems architects at a deep technical level.

Ways to stand out from the crowd

• Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Dynamo, NIXL, Grove, or emerging disaggregated inference tooling.

• Understanding of GPU memory hierarchies and high-speed interconnects (NVLink, InfiniBand, RDMA, UCX).

• You have contributed to advanced AI lab or large scale AI infrastructure providers performing inference on thousands of GPUs.

• Published work or benchmarks in large-scale AI inference.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

description:
【Job Responsibilities】

• Lead the design of financial logic and core risk control models for perpetual contracts, including but not limited to the continuous iteration of the funding rate model, tiered margin system, Auto-Deleveraging (ADL), and forced liquidation logic, ensuring the system can withstand extreme unilateral market movements and severe volatility.

• Establish and refine the daily risk monitoring framework, track funding rate fluctuations, user position exposure distribution, and order book liquidity depth in real-time, and promptly identify and alert on potential risks based on on-chain/off-chain data.

• Coordinate the execution of risk control requirements, driving the full lifecycle management of risk control strategies from requirement analysis, development, and testing to launch and final acceptance, ensuring high-quality implementation.
【Job Requirements】

• Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related fields.

• 2+ years of experience in Crypto derivatives, risk management, or product design, with a profound understanding of the operational mechanisms of perpetual contracts.

• Excellent communication and coordination skills, coupled with strong logical thinking; outstanding cross-departmental collaboration and a proven ability to drive projects; highly responsible, maintaining a keen risk awareness tailored to the fast-paced Web3 market environment.

• Prior experience with contract or risk control products at top-tier CEX/DEX is highly preferred.
【About Us】
Davion Labs is currently inviting a Risk Manager (Financial Contract Products) with a strong background in derivatives and exceptional risk model design capabilities to join the core team of ApeX Protocol.
Incubated by Davion Labs, ApeX Protocol is an industry-leading, innovative decentralized exchange (DEX) platform committed to providing users with an efficient, transparent, and secure cryptocurrency trading environment. Amidst the continuous explosive growth of Web3 technologies and the digital asset derivatives market, we are actively strengthening our underlying architecture, focusing on risk control mechanism innovation and trading experience upgrades. We aim to redefine the decentralized trading landscape through top-tier liquidation engines and a comprehensive product portfolio.
Our core product, ApeX Omni (v2), offers multi-chain liquidity, a flexible and user-centric design, and top-level security guarantees powered by zero-knowledge proofs. To build a solid "moat" for this top-tier, financial-grade business system and ensure the absolute safety of the platform's liquidity pools and user assets, we are continuously iterating and upgrading our core risk control framework.
As the Risk Manager (Financial Contract Products), you will be deeply involved in the construction and iteration of the underlying risk control logic for the ApeX protocol. You will play a decisive role in everything from the precise calibration of the perpetual contract funding rate model and the optimization of the tiered margin system, to the robust implementation of liquidation logic and auto-deleveraging (ADL) mechanisms under extreme market conditions. We look forward to you leveraging your extensive experience in derivative risk control and keen awareness of extreme market risks to collaborate closely with our R&D and quantitative teams. Together, we will safeguard the bottom line of trading security and build a resilient, efficient, and top-tier Web3 trading ecosystem.

• 建立并完善日常风控监控体系，实时追踪资金费率波动、用户持仓敞口分布及盘口流动性深度，基于链上/链下数据及时识别并预警潜在风险。

【任职要求】

• 具备 2 年以上 Crypto 衍生品或风控/产品设计经验，对永续合约的运行机制有较深的理解。

• 具备出色的沟通协调能力，逻辑思维能力；优秀的跨部门协作与项目推动力；极具责任心，在快节奏的 Web3 市场环境中保持敏锐的风险嗅觉。

title: Business Development Representative
description:
​
​
​Job Description - Business Development Representative
Location - In-Office (Waco, TX) or Remote
Role Type - Full-Time Role
Job Description
AxisCare is seeking an experienced, driven, and highly motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to help accelerate our sales and growth goals. We are looking for someone with a proven background in business development, outbound sales, prospecting, pipeline generation, or a similar sales-focused role. The ideal candidate understands how to identify opportunities, engage decision-makers, overcome objections, and create meaningful conversations that ultimately generate qualified opportunities for our sales team.
As a BDR, you will be on the front lines of introducing AxisCare to prospective customers. You will be responsible for researching and identifying target accounts, developing outbound strategies, connecting with key decision-makers, qualifying opportunities, and creating enough value and interest to move prospects through the sales process. You will work closely with our Sales and Growth teams to develop and execute strategic outreach plans while consistently building and maintaining healthy pipeline.
Experience selling into the home care industry, working within the home care industry, or selling SaaS or technology solutions to home care agencies is a strong plus. Candidates who understand the challenges, buying process, decision-makers, and competitive landscape within the home care industry will be especially valuable in this role.
Our ideal BDR is someone who does not simply “make calls.” You understand how to research an account, develop a point of view, personalize outreach, navigate conversations with business owners and decision-makers, uncover pain points, handle objections, and create opportunities where there may not initially appear to be one. You are competitive, coachable, resilient, and highly accountable for your results. You are comfortable with rejection, motivated by goals, team collaboration, and excited by the opportunity to build pipeline and directly impact company growth.
Key Responsibilities

• Research, identify, and develop a targeted list of prospective home care agencies and other ideal customer accounts.

• Build and execute strategic outbound prospecting plans across phone, email, LinkedIn and other communication channels.

• Identify and engage key decision-makers, including agency owners, operators, executives, and other stakeholders involved in the software purchasing process.

• Conduct thoughtful account and contact research to create relevant, personalized outreach.

• Create new opportunities through cold calling, emailing, social selling, networking, and other outbound prospecting methods.

• Qualify prospects by uncovering their business needs, current processes, challenges, goals, timeline, decision-making structure, and potential fit with AxisCare.

• Clearly communicate the value of AxisCare and create interest in learning more about our platform.

• Effectively handle objections and maintain conversations with prospects who may initially be hesitant or uninterested.

• Develop and execute nurture strategies for prospects who may not be ready to purchase

• immediately but represent strong future opportunities.

• Partner closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to ensure qualified opportunities are properly prepared and transitioned into the next stage of the sales process.

• Maintain accurate and up to date prospect, account, activity, and pipeline information within HubSpot CRM.

• Utilize AxisCare marketing materials, sales enablement resources, case studies, and other content to provide prospects with relevant information throughout their buying journey.

• Consistently meet and exceed activity, pipeline generation, and qualified opportunity goals.

• Continuously develop your knowledge of the home care industry, AxisCare’s platform, competitors, and the challenges our customers face.

Why this role
Evolve is on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone, and that starts with the homeowners who trust us with their properties. Signing with Evolve is only the start. Before an owner earns a dollar, their home has to be set up, photographed, permitted, priced and listed - and every one of those steps is a place where owners stall or drop off.
As Principal Product Manager for Activation, you'll own that journey, from signed agreement to a live, bookable listing. You'll be measured on how many owners go live, how quickly, and whether they're still with us six months later - not just on activation volume. The levers are known and largely unowned today: property setup, photo scheduling, permits and compliance, rates, and multi-property onboarding. Your job is to turn them into a roadmap and move the number.
The team
Growth owns Evolve 's owner-acquisition funnel, from first impression through qualified lead and signup, and all of our marketing. This role extends Growth's product work past signup into activation, working side by side with the Onboarding team that runs the process today.
What you’ll do

• Own the product roadmap from signed agreement to a live, bookable listing, with activation rate, time to live and 180-day retained activations as the measures of success

• Own activation instrumentation with analytics, so every step from signup to live can be measured by cohort

• Partnership

• Work closely with Onboarding and Operations, who run the process today, to change the system underneath it rather than adding more manual work

• Talk to owners - single-property and portfolio - and turn what you learn into product decisions

What makes you a great fit

• 8+ years of product management, with meaningful time owning onboarding, activation or time-to-value

• Experience partnering with operations or field teams to automate manual processes

• Nice to have: experience with compliance-heavy or regulated onboarding (permits, licensing or credentialing), with vacation rental, real estate, hospitality or property management, and with multi-property or business customers alongside individual ones

Compensation
Annual base salary range: $190,000 - $210,000 depending on relevant experience. This role will also be eligible to receive a variable annual b

title: Staff/Principal Engineer, Search & Retrieval
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is building the infrastructure for autonomous science: AI systems that design experiments, run them in physical labs, and close the loop across life sciences, chemistry, and materials science. Our platform enables this to operate reliably at scale for external customers who require security, auditability, and operational rigor.

We're hiring a Staff/Principal Engineer, Search & Retrieval (Enterprise AI) to own how scientists and agents ask questions of scientific knowledge at Lila: published literature and patents, customer-supplied documents, lab protocols, and the structured experimental record.

Your work will involve building RAG over unstructured text and a scientific knowledge graph that links literature to the structured experimental record.

Enterprise customers require one retrieval platform that any scientific workload can build on, with tenancy enforced in the index and the graph rather than the application layer. You will own that stack end to end, from ingestion to retrieval to cited answers a scientist can trace back to the evidence.

This is a deeply technical senior individual contributor role. We move fast, ship often, and look for engineers who do well with ambiguity and enjoy shaping the problem as much as solving it.

What You'll Be Building

• Technical leadership across platform engineering, infrastructure, AI/ML, and scientific teams. Broad architectural influence, high autonomy, direct ownership of critical platform systems.

• Define the shared retrieval foundation. Your architecture decisions become the default for scientific workloads across the company, well beyond the first one you ship.

• Knowledge graph and graph retrieval. Build one scientific knowledge graph from literature and the structured experimental record. Own graph retrieval and its fusion with vector and lexical search into a single cited answer.

• Agentic search. Build the autonomous research loop, from query planning through retrieval to traceable reasoning.

• Retrieval quality. Own the retrieval pipeline end to end and the evaluation harness.

• Ingestion and extraction. Own the pipeline that turns the many types of scientific data (PDFs, patents, lab protocols, and more) into semantically searchable evidence.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 8+ years of software development experience, including production ownership of a search, retrieval, RAG, or knowledge graph system that real users depended on.

• Production experience building semantic search: embedding models, vector indexes (HNSW/IVF), hybrid lexical and vector retrieval, and reranking. Graph database experience is a strong plus.

• Track record in high-growth environments where speed-to-value mattered as much as long-term architecture.

• You can describe how you measured retrieval quality (recall, groundedness, citation accuracy) and how you caught regressions.

• Hands-on coding in Python and modern backend frameworks (FastAPI, async Python).

• Modern cloud-native architectures (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS).

• Strong cross-functional communication and the ability to influence architecture across teams.

• BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points For

• Shipped RAG or semantic search in a regulated or enterprise context, through security and compliance review under regimes such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GxP (including ALCOA+ data integrity), or FedRAMP.

• Permission-aware retrieval over access-controlled data.

• Document understanding at scale: OCR, layout-aware parsing, table and figure extraction from scientific literature.

• Agentic retrieval and GraphRAG patterns, and how to evaluate them.

• Platforms serving scientific or laboratory data such as LIMS, ELN, bioinformatics, or materials informatics, with an understanding of provenance and traceability requirements.

• Domain-specific corpora and scientific ontologies (UMLS, MeSH, ChEBI, GO, UniProt, Materials Project) w

title: Senior Product Design Engineer
description:
At Rohlik Group, we are building the future of e-grocery for over a million active customers across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania. We own our entire technology stack - from storefronts and apps to automated fulfillment centers and last-mile logistics.

Within the Customer Experience (CUEX) domain, we own every touchpoint a customer interacts with, from the homepage to checkout and real-time order tracking across web, iOS, and Android. Our five storefronts run on a single product spine with localized content, pricing, and brand layers. We operate as a deliberately tight-knit, high-performing team where a Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, two Product Designers, and a dedicated full-stack engineering team ship fast, iterate constantly, and take full ownership of the end-to-end user journey.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues - they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. As Senior Product Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design of all customer-facing surfaces across five markets. You will also manage our design system, Maia (our AI shopping assistant), and provide the design guidance that powers our automated coding workflows.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- High-impact Group scope: Design every customer-facing touchpoint across web, iOS, and Android for five international markets, impacting millions of orders.

- True end-to-end ownership: Lead the complete lifecycle of product design - from initial problem definition and customer research to shipped A/B tests and real-world performance analysis.

- AI-first execution: Rohlik is an AI-first company. You’ll own the interface design for Maia, our AI shopping assistant, and build the structured design system guidance used by AI coding agents to generate on-brand code without hand-coding interfaces.

- Direct customer engagement: Lead user research and usability testing sessions directly with real shoppers, rather than commissioning external agencies or receiving filtered insights.

- High accountability, low overhead: Work in a small, autonomous team where design decisions move straight to production and work that doesn't deliver measured impact is honestly reverted.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN AND DELIVER

- Customer Surfaces: Own the end-to-end design and UX strategy across web, iOS, and Android for all core journey stages: homepage, search & browse, product pages, basket, slot selection, checkout, and order tracking.

- Design System as a Product: Own component architecture, design tokens, patterns, and documentation, ensuring our coding agents have precise design guidance to generate accurate interfaces.

- AI Experience Design: Define the interaction patterns for Maia (our AI shopping assistant), governing when it intervenes, how it presents information, and how it hands over to human support.

- Experimentation & Analysis: Drive hypotheses, prototype rapidly, and evaluate A/B test results objectively - scaling successful experiments and sunsetting features that miss target performance.

- Direct User Research: Conduct qualitative interviews, usability tests, and field research directly with customers to continuously uncover friction points.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, and your peer product designer, while providing design input to Commercial, Marketing, and Operations.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products with a strong portfolio of shipped work across both web and native mobile (iOS and Android).

- Advanced Figma & Design System expertise: Deep, hands-on experience building, scaling, and architecting multi-platform design systems at the token and component level.

- Data-fluent mindset: Ability to read and rigorously interpret A/B testing data, distinguishing genuine impact from vanity metrics.

- Fluency with AI tooling: Practical exp

Job Title: Grant Reviewer, Community Schools (CSII)
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: Remote, United States

Position Summary
Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring Grant Reviewers on behalf of the Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE), the District of Columbia's state education agency, for its Community Schools Incentive Initiative (CSII) grant competition. OSSE is seeking reviewers with hands-on experience in community school models and integrated student supports who can evaluate the quality of school-community partnerships and implementation plans.
Grant reviewers provide independent subject matter expertise to read, score, and comment on competitive grant applications submitted by local education agencies, schools, community-based organizations, and other eligible entities. All reviews are completed remotely in OSSE's online Enterprise Grants Management System (EGMS), and reviewer scores are used to recommend applications for funding. OSSE selects reviewers from the qualified pool and gives preference to reviewers who have satisfactorily completed reviews for its competitions in previous years.
Work Schedule
This is a remote, part-time assignment. Reviews are completed on your own schedule within each deadline. The approximate commitment for this competition is:

• Orientation and EGMS training: a virtual webinar held approximately within two weeks of the engagement start date.

• Review window: usually two weeks from the date applications are assigned, unless OSSE specifies otherwise.

• Facilitated discussion (only if needed): a phone or video conference, usually about three business days after the scoring due date, held when panel scores differ significantly.

• Approximate completion of reviewer work: June 15, 2027. Final dates are confirmed before orientation.

Key Responsibilities

• Complete OSSE's EGMS training and attend the virtual, grant-specific orientation webinar before reviewing any applications.

• Independently read and conduct a detailed review of each assigned application (typically two or more per competition) as one of three reviewers on an EGMS review panel, working remotely and separately.

• Assess each application's alignment with community school pillars and the feasibility of its proposed implementation plan.

• Evaluate partnership quality and collaboration structures, including partnership memoranda of understanding (MOUs), stakeholder engagement plans, community needs assessments, and strategies for shared leadership.

• Analyze data, budgets, and needs assessments for accuracy, alignment, and responsiveness to identified community priorities.

• Complete a fully scored rubric for every section of each application, applying the established scoring criteria consistently and objectively.

• Write clear, constructive comments describing strengths and weaknesses that justify and align with the scores given. Reviews may be shared with applicants on request, with reviewer names and contact information removed.

• Base all scores and comments only on the content of each applicant's submission in EGMS.

• Submit all scores and comments in EGMS by the review deadline, usually two weeks from receiving the applications.

• Participate in a facilitated panel discussion by phone or video conference when scores differ significantly, then submit a final rubric with updated scores and comments reflecting any changes.

• Disclose any conflict of interest with applicant organizations and do not review any application where a conflict exists.

• Direct EGMS technical questions to the EGMS manual, the resources at grants.osse.dc.gov, or the EGMS call center at (202) 719-6500, and direct questions about the grant or about scoring to OSSE grant program staff.

• Bachelor's degree or higher.

title: Senior Video Editor: Direct Response Ads
description:
Senior Video Editor: Direct Response Ads
Remote | Full-time independent contractor | $3,500 to $5,000 USD a month + winner bonuses | At least 4 hours a day overlapping 10am to 6pm Dubai time
You've edited hundreds of ads. How do you know which ones worked?
Most editors cut what they're handed, send it off and never find out. You get a brief you didn't write, for a hook you'd have done differently, and nobody tells you the result. If you only want to be handed a brief and cut it, this isn't for you.
Eyeball Factory is a Dubai performance creative agency working with fast-growing e-commerce and health brands on Meta and TikTok. Our founders built and sold a 7-figure e-commerce brand and grew a media company to 95,000 newsletter subscribers. We run on AI and we move fast.
The job

• Cut fast-paced direct response ads: VSLs, UGC and creator cuts, hook stacks, AI UGC, AI explainers and animated ads

• Use AI tools (avatars, voice, AI b-roll, image-to-video) to make formats a typical editor can't

• Bring your own hooks, structures and visual concepts. We want your brain, not only your hands

Your KPI: 20 minutes of edited video per week.
Your first 30 days
You go through intensive training: our own courses, daily calls with the founders, feedback on everything you make, and practice writing hooks, briefs and scripts yourself.
By the end of it, you're not just an editor. You're a Creative Producer. You decide what ad gets made and why, write the hook and the brief, get it produced, and read the numbers to decide what comes next. Over time, the role grows into leading creative operations and delivery.
The pay
$3,500 to $5,000 USD a month depending on experience, plus bonuses when your ads become winners.
It's a high number because this is three jobs in one: the craft, the AI stack, and the judgment to know why an ad converts.
You're a fit if

• You have 3+ years editing paid social ads, ideally for e-commerce, direct response, supplements, info products or affiliates

• You can show ads that actually ran

• You've made AI UGC, AI avatar or AI-generated ads. We'll ask which tools and what they replaced

• You've picked up a new AI tool in the last few months and it changed what you can make

• Multiple ads a day doesn't scare you

• Your English is strong enough to follow scripts precisely

• You can give at least 4 hours a day overlapping 10am to 6pm Dubai time

You're not a fit if

• Your portfolio is mostly brand films, weddings or vlogs

• You only want to edit and never think about why an ad works

• You need days to turn around one ad

How to apply

• Record a 2-3 minute Loom: pick one ad you edited and walk us through it. What was the hook, why did you choose that structure, and what would you change now?

• Fill out our application form with your portfolio link (ads only) and your Loom link:

• No Loom, no review. We watch every one.

Our process
Application with Loom, intro interview, call with our founder, paid 2-week trial, final interview, offer.

title: AI Factory Mechanical Engineer
description:
NVIDIA owned the way in accelerated computing to address problems beyond the reach of standard computers. Its creation of the GPU in 1999 ignited the expansion of PC gaming and transformed modern computer graphics. Now, NVIDIA drives AI forward as a full-stack computing firm. Its data center platforms fuel the upcoming industrial revolution, where intelligence is the product. Our efforts cover accelerated computing, AI, robotics, and the vital data center infrastructure. NVIDIA is now creating AI factories: custom facilities that generate intelligence at unmatched scale and density in data centers. These are not typical data centers; they require power- and cooling-heavy production setups with innovative mechanical systems, new build standards, and fresh engineering leadership. As NVIDIA expands, we seek outstanding engineers who continuously learn, are passionate about their work, and aspire to perform at their highest level.

The growth of NVIDIA 's accelerated computing and AI infrastructure surpasses historical data center development and operation speeds. We want a highly motivated AI Factory Mechanical Design Engineer to take charge of next-generation liquid cooling and thermal systems for AI factories. Your responsibility will cover all phases, from concept to construction and commissioning, at a scale rarely seen before. This position is not about reviewing others' designs; you will be the engineering authority for systems lacking an established guide. You will join a small, high-impact team where your choices directly influence what is developed. You will set technical direction across hydronic, airside, and facility heat-rejection systems, mentor engineers across the organization, and drive programs that bring real megawatts of AI compute capacity online. Current focus areas include the technical roadmap for advanced mechanical systems, programmatic facility plans, owner-furnished equipment strategy, and adapting standardized plans to local site conditions.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Lead data center product and facility builds, balancing cost, energy efficiency, schedule, and sustainability while integrating new technologies.

• Own mechanical systems strategy and development, including liquid cooling, chiller plants, heat rejection, CDUs, and airside/hydronic systems, from concept through construction administration and commissioning.

• Deliver design documentation and lead execution across all project phases (SD, DD, CD, CA) for greenfield, leased, and retrofit projects.

• Partner with civil/structural, electrical, connectivity, controls, and hardware engineering to align rack-level thermal requirements with facility design, optimized for cost, speed, efficiency, and flexibility.

• Drive prefabricated and modular construction strategies and build-to-break-ground schedules to accelerate deployment.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

title: Staff Accountant, Accounts Payable
description:
The Staff Accountant  of Accounts Payable owns day-to-day processing of non-PO invoices, including reaching out to vendors to confirm service periods and invoice details, coordinating with Finance Business Partners to confirm cost center and budget coding, and working with Accounting leadership to resolve coding questions in gray-area situations. This role also supports the P2P inbox, vendor onboarding and validation, vendor relationship ownership, and backs up expense report review. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates clearly via email, thinks independently, and is comfortable using AI tools (such as Claude) to improve and automate AP processes.
 
We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.
 
 

Who We Are:
Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.
 
What Does This Mean for You?
At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
 
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
 
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
